en.short_description: Video hub    like videos cloud server
en.subtitle: Stock video, worth watching
en.description:
YourTube is a clean way to watch high-quality stock video on your phone or TV.

WATCH
Browse trending and by category, search for what you want, or flick through short-form vertical video. The player supports captions, a queue, and a data-saver mode for when you are not on Wi-Fi.

FOR YOU
A recommendation feed that learns from what you watch. It is built on your activity in this app only, and you can see what it does in Settings.

SAVE IT
Watch Later holds anything you want to come back to. Clear it whenever.

MADE FOR THE BIG SCREEN TOO
YourTube detects a TV and switches to a layout you can drive with a remote.

Sign in with Google or Apple to keep your list across devices, or browse without an account. YourTube shows ads.
